notes: Clean dark-theme UI with clear visual hierarchy: search bar at top, facets left, results right, score breakdown with horizontal bars on click. Error state shows positional caret which is a nice touch, though the empty table header showing behind the error feels unpolished. Backend has proper inverted indexes with bisect for numeric ranges and a pred_cache, but facets endpoint iterates all matching candidates to recompute skill/location counts (no precomputed facet index), and scoring iterates all matched IDs without any top-k optimization, which will hurt at 150k scale with broad queries. Single-file monolith with inline HTML is functional but not how you'd ship production code; parsing, indexing, scoring, and HTTP should be separate modules. The query parser is well-structured with proper error positions.
